title: Collision-Free Is Not Enough: Passage-Conditioned Navigation for Wheeled-Legged Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.25788v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A collision-free detour can still bring a legged robot to the next stair or ledge a few centimetres or degrees off, and a fixed locomotion skill, factory or learned, can stall or fall. Existing methods prevent this with a robot model or extensive trial and error, but on a new site with unknown skills neither is available, so they cannot be used. We find that a single 27-minute teaching session already supplies what these methods have to derive or learn: for every stair and ledge, one crossing the skill has completed. Our method, passage-conditioned navigation, makes the route remember how each transition was entered, not only where the path went. It stores each taught crossing as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces it after every local replan: before each ledge, an entry gate makes the robot turn or back up and retry if it is more than 10 cm or 10{\deg} off the taught crossing. translated_title: 仅有无碰撞还不够：轮腿式机器人的通道条件导航
translated_abstract: 无碰撞的绕行路径仍可能把足式机器人带到下一个台阶或矮墙处时偏差几厘米或几度，而固定的运动技能（无论是工厂预设的还是学习得到的）就会卡住或摔倒。现有方法依靠机器人模型或大量试错来防止这种情况，但在技能未知的新场地上，这两者都无法获得，因此不能使用。我们发现，仅仅一次27分钟的示教过程就已经提供了这些方法必须推导或学习的内容：为每个台阶和矮墙记录一次该技能已成功完成的通过。我们的方法——通道条件导航——让路线记住每次过渡是如何进入的，而不仅仅是路径经过了哪里。它将每次示教的通过存储为一个事件，无需训练或机器人模型，就能在每次局部重规划后强制执行：在每个矮墙前，入口门控会在机器人偏离示教通过位置超过10厘米或10度时，让其转身或后退重试。在定位噪声下，随着路径……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出通道条件导航方法：仅用27分钟示教记录每次成功通过台阶/矮墙的事件，无需训练或机器人模型，即可在每次局部重规划后通过入口门控强制机器人按示教的位置和姿态进入通道，偏差超过10厘米或10度则重试，从而避免无碰撞路径仍导致固定运动技能卡住或摔倒。
en_tdlr: Passage-conditioned navigation stores each taught crossing from a single 27-minute demonstration session as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces entry gates after every local replan—making the robot turn or back up and retry if more than 10 cm or 10° off the taught crossing—so that a collision-free route can no longer lead a fixed locomotion skill to stall or fall at stairs and ledges.
